Golden morning light, vivid saturated greens, joyful, adventurous, full of air and light. No people close to camera, no signage, no number plate.

Very dark, brooding overcast light with a cold blue-grey grade, deeply shadowed greens, wet grass texture in the foreground, the car small and centred in the lower third of the frame. Cinematic, still, completely silent. No people, no road, no buildings, no number plate, no badges.
